shortDescription: Information module for Network Device Image Updates

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. Image update started before the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: hostName
options.description: HostName query parameter. Host name of the network device for the image update. Supports case- insensitive partial search.

options.name: id
options.description: Id query parameter. Update id which is unique for each network device under the parentId.

options.name: imageName
options.description: ImageName query parameter. Software image name for the update.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. The minimum and maximum values are 1 and 500, respectively.

options.name: managementAddress
options.description: ManagementAddress query parameter. Management address of the network device.

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: NetworkDeviceId query parameter. Network device id.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response.

options.name: parentId
options.description: ParentId query parameter. Updates that have this parent id.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Image update started after the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

options.name: status
options.description: Status query parameter. Status of the image update. Available values FAILURE, SUCCESS, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
